VdbeState.doc: Mutable execution state: register file, cursor slots, program counter, return stack, aggregate and window sessions. Sub-parts use the methods declared below; direct field access is forbidden.

VdbeState.name: num_registers
VdbeState.doc: Upper bound of the register file; Register values are in [0, num_registers).

VdbeState.name: get_register
VdbeState.doc: Immutable view of the value in register r. Panics on out-of-bounds — caller (well-formed program) must not trigger.

VdbeState.name: set_register
VdbeState.doc: Move v into register r, releasing any prior owned payload.

VdbeState.name: take_register
VdbeState.doc: Move the value out of register r and return it as an owned Value; the register is left holding Value::Null. Panics on out-of-bounds — caller (well-formed program) must not trigger. This is the Move-without-clone primitive: Text/Blob payloads are transferred, not copied.

VdbeState.name: set_pc
VdbeState.doc: Set the program counter. Caller ensures pc is within the Program.

VdbeState.name: return_stack_push
VdbeState.doc: Push a return address onto the Gosub/Return stack. Returns Err(OpcodeIllegal) if depth exceeds RETURN_STACK_MAX_DEPTH.

VdbeState.name: return_stack_pop
VdbeState.doc: Pop the top return address. Returns Err(OpcodeIllegal) if the stack is empty.

VdbeState.name: cursor_is_open
VdbeState.doc: True iff the cursor slot currently holds an open handle.

VdbeState.name: set_cursor
VdbeState.doc: Install a cursor handle at slot c, releasing any prior handle at that slot (replace-on-write).

VdbeState.name: take_cursor
VdbeState.doc: Move out the cursor handle at slot c. Leaves the slot empty. None if already empty (idempotent).

VdbeState.name: db
VdbeState.doc: Borrow the storage database handle. Used by OpenRead/OpenWrite and by any opcode that calls into storage.
